scope: Python coordination tooling; no native game addresses or ABI changes

incident.source: Integrator handoff; separate repair performed before this packet

implementation.lock: Persistent leases.lock with OS-held exclusivity around the complete read/check/modify/replace
implementation.windows_lock: CreateFileW GENERIC_READ|GENERIC_WRITE, share mode 0, OPEN_ALWAYS, non-inheritable handle
implementation.lock_reclamation: None; no expiry/PID reclamation or unlink on timeout
implementation.publication: Unique same-directory NamedTemporaryFile; flush, fsync, close, os.replace
implementation.unlocked_save: Rejected before any write; callers must read within lease_transaction

validation.isolation: Fresh TemporaryDirectory; explicit BSP_COORDINATION_DIR in parent and every child
validation.live_registry_operations: Only normal own lease claims and releases
additional_checks: Live-holder timeout does not steal lock or change registry
Real Windows deny-sharing handle causes retry then successful replacement
Serialization failure leaves published bytes unchanged and cleans own temporary file
Existing malformed JSON is surfaced and preserved
validation.first_iteration_finding: Concurrent pathlib.open raised PermissionError errno 13 without winerror; Windows CRT retry form added and fixture passed

limitations: Older worktree writers ignore leases.lock and remain unsafe until all active writer checkouts and already-imported processes are upgraded
Integration and deployment to other worktrees are not performed by this worker
POSIX flock fallback is untested here
Abrupt termination can leave an unused unique temporary file
No automatic repair of historical corruption or claim of full power-loss durability
